lines.zh: 我在麦田里走，脚印留在垄沟。
lines.en: I walk the wheat field, prints left in the furrows.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩得很轻，你听不见。
lines.en: My hooves step lightly; you will not hear.

lines.zh: 我绕着篱笆走，找那段矮的。
lines.en: I circle the fence, looking for the low stretch.

lines.zh: 夜里我走得更慢，因为要听。
lines.en: I walk slower at night, because I must listen.

lines.zh: 这片地里的胡萝卜少了几棵。
lines.en: A few carrots are missing from this plot.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在墙上，像根烟囱。
lines.en: My shadow clings to the wall like a chimney.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，草朝一边倒。
lines.en: Where I step, the grass leans to one side.

lines.zh: 我往村口走，再往林子里绕。
lines.en: I head for the village gate, then loop to the woods.

lines.zh: 我的角刮过低枝，声音很小。
lines.en: My horns scrape a low branch, very softly.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，走同一路线。
lines.en: I follow your prints and walk the same route.

lines.zh: 这条路我熟悉，比你熟。
lines.en: I know this road better than you do.

lines.zh: 雪地上留着我的两趾痕。
lines.en: My two-toed tracks remain in the snow.

lines.zh: 我走过火把，光就断一截。
lines.en: I pass a torch and its light breaks off.

lines.zh: 别回头，走路的人不该回头。
lines.en: Do not look back; walkers should never look back.

lines.zh: 我学着牛的叫声，练了三遍。
lines.en: I practice a cow's lowing three times.

lines.zh: 田里的稻草人比我安静。
lines.en: The scarecrow in the field is quieter than I.

lines.zh: 我蹲在屋顶，等一个声音。
lines.en: I crouch on the roof, waiting for a sound.

lines.zh: 牙齿磨着角根，有点痒。
lines.en: My teeth grind near the horn base; it itches.

lines.zh: 我掰了根玉米，只咬一口。
lines.en: I break off a corn cob and take a single bite.

lines.zh: 风穿过角上的纹路，会响。
lines.en: Wind passes through the grooves of my horns and whistles.

lines.zh: 我在数村里亮着的窗。
lines.en: I am counting the lit windows in the village.

lines.zh: 这一带的狗都不叫了。
lines.en: The dogs around here have all stopped barking.

lines.zh: 我试着模仿鸡叫，学得不像。
lines.en: I try a chicken's cluck and get it wrong.

lines.zh: 我把爪子收着，免得刮响木栏。
lines.en: I keep my claws in so the wooden fence stays quiet.

lines.zh: 月亮照在我眼睛里，是横的。
lines.en: The moon in my eyes lies sideways.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁傀儡的味道，走远些。
lines.en: I smell an iron golem and move farther off.

lines.zh: 这片庄稼，我吃着，也护着。
lines.en: I eat this crop, and I also guard it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我想听人说话。
lines.en: In the quiet, I want to hear someone speak.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，那就不能放你走。
lines.en: You have seen me, so I cannot let you go.

lines.zh: 看得太久，眼睛会记住你。
lines.en: Stare too long and my eyes will remember you.

lines.zh: 你站得太近了，退后一点。
lines.en: Too close for comfort; give me a pace.

lines.zh: 我的脸你记住了吧。
lines.en: You have memorized my face, yes?

lines.zh: 你也听见那声牛叫了吧？
lines.en: You heard that cow call too, did you not?

lines.zh: 我本来只是路过。
lines.en: I was only passing through, at first.

lines.zh: 你抬手的样子，我记下了。
lines.en: I have noted the way you raised your hand.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊了也没人应。
lines.en: Shout if you like; nobody is coming for you.

lines.zh: 你身上有麦秆的味道。
lines.en: You smell of wheat stalks.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，这样挺好。
lines.en: You stay still and so do I; that is fine.

lines.zh: 你的窗户没有关严。
lines.en: Your window is not fully shut.

lines.zh: 看够了就转开，我数三下。
lines.en: Look your fill, then turn away; I count three.

lines.zh: 手腕的位置我记下了。
lines.en: I have marked the position of your wrist.

lines.zh: 流血了，我得先走。
lines.en: I am bleeding; I must go first.

lines.zh: 角根一麻，我咬住了牙。
lines.en: My horn base went numb and I clenched my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的刀口偏了半寸。
lines.en: Your blade went half an inch wide.

lines.zh: 角根被打到，眼前一白。
lines.en: A hit at the horn base, and my sight went white.

lines.zh: 我退开，是为了等下次。
lines.en: I withdraw, so that I may wait for next time.

lines.zh: 你会为这一刀付出更多。
lines.en: You will pay far more for that cut.

lines.zh: 血滴在雪上，我不擦。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the snow; I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 别跟着我，我受了伤。
lines.en: Do not follow me; I am wounded.

lines.zh: 角断了就归你，别急。
lines.en: When my horn breaks it is yours; be patient.

lines.zh: 你的食物？我吃田里的。
lines.en: Your food? I eat from the fields.

lines.zh: 把胡萝卜举起来，我不接。
lines.en: Hold up the carrot; I will not take it.

lines.zh: 地里长的比手里的香。
lines.en: What grows in the ground tastes better.

lines.zh: 你拿诱饵钓一个传说？
lines.en: You bait a legend with that?

lines.zh: 我只在没人看的时候吃。
lines.en: I only eat when no one is watching.

lines.zh: 这块面包太软，咬不动。
lines.en: This bread is too soft to bite.

lines.zh: 放下篮子，走远些。
lines.en: Put the basket down and walk away.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候会自己去田里。
lines.en: When hungry, I go to the field myself.

lines.zh: 你的手一直在抖。
lines.en: Your hand has not stopped shaking.

lines.zh: 食物换不来我的安静。
lines.en: Food cannot buy my silence.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我会记住你。
lines.en: Do not come so close; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的那刻，规则变了。
lines.en: The moment you bumped me, the rules changed.

lines.zh: 我的骨头比看起来硬。
lines.en: My frame is sturdier than this thin coat suggests.

lines.zh: 退开，我不喜欢被碰。
lines.en: Back off; I dislike being touched.

lines.zh: 这一下，算你先动的手。
lines.en: That one counts as you striking first.

lines.zh: 我站得很稳，蹄子抓地。
lines.en: I stand firm; my hooves grip the ground.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我胸口，很轻。
lines.en: Your shoulder against my chest, very light.

lines.zh: 再挤一次，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Push once more and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，是为了看清你。
lines.en: I stepped back to see you better.

lines.zh: 撞坏了篱笆，你要赔。
lines.en: You broke the fence; you will pay for it.

lines.zh: 传说不需要第二个。
lines.en: A legend has no need for a second.

lines.zh: 林子里没有母山羊等我。
lines.en: No doe waits for me in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的角只用来顶人。
lines.en: My horns are only for goring.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我不做那种事。
lines.en: Do not come near; I do not do that.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢独自蹲在屋顶。
lines.en: I prefer crouching on a roof alone.

lines.zh: 看着我的人，最后都搬走了。
lines.en: Those who watched me all moved away.

lines.zh: 这条路只留一串蹄印。
lines.en: This road keeps only one set of hoofprints.

lines.zh: 同类？我记不清了。
lines.en: My own kind? I cannot quite remember.

lines.zh: 你问得太多了。
lines.en: You ask far too many questions.

lines.zh: 夜里我只跟自己的影子走。
lines.en: At night I walk only with my shadow.

lines.zh: 这把锄头，我先借走。
lines.en: I will borrow this hoe for a while.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，我收着。
lines.en: Things dropped on the ground, I keep.

lines.zh: 我把你的靴子藏在草垛下。
lines.en: I hide your boots under the haystack.

lines.zh: 这块布我闻了三遍，是你的。
lines.en: I sniffed this cloth three times; it is yours.

lines.zh: 捡起来，埋到绑架的地方。
lines.en: Pick it up and bury it where I take you.

lines.zh: 一枚钥匙，正好。
lines.en: A key; how convenient.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进角旁边的小洞。
lines.en: I stuff it into the small hollow by my horn.

lines.zh: 这东西很轻，藏起来不难。
lines.en: This is light; easy to hide.

lines.zh: 你丢了它，会来找的。
lines.en: You will come looking once it is gone.

lines.zh: 我拿走一件，你就会少一件。
lines.en: Each thing I take leaves you one fewer.

lines.zh: 你看了我四秒，够了。
lines.en: You looked at me four seconds; that is enough.

lines.zh: 你走过来的时候，我就决定了。
lines.en: I decided the moment you walked over.

lines.zh: 这次我不杀，只带走。
lines.en: This time I will not kill, only take.

lines.zh: 你的门没锁，省了我力气。
lines.en: Your door was unlocked, saving me effort.

lines.zh: 我听到你的呼吸变了。
lines.en: I heard your breathing change.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的蹄子就先动了。
lines.en: You move, and my hooves move first.

lines.zh: 狼不在这边，铁傀儡也不在。
lines.en: No wolves here, no iron golem either.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see the tree behind you.

lines.zh: 我记住你家在哪个方向。
lines.en: I know which way your home lies.

lines.zh: 今晚的月亮够亮，看得清路。
lines.en: The moon is bright enough to light the way.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: The thing in your hand does not interest me.

lines.zh: 我要的是你走一趟。
lines.en: What I want is for you to take a walk.

lines.zh: 脚步声停了，说明你知道了。
lines.en: Your steps stopped, which means you know.

lines.zh: 这是我们第二次见面了。
lines.en: This is our second meeting.

lines.zh: 我走在你后面，一直没出声。
lines.en: I walk behind you and never make a sound.

lines.zh: 你回头三次，我都躲开了。
lines.en: You looked back three times; I avoided each.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的节奏走。
lines.en: I walk in your rhythm.

lines.zh: 你拐进小巷，我也拐。
lines.en: You turn into the alley, and so do I.

lines.zh: 别停，停下来我就到身边。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop I am beside you.

lines.zh: 这条街的火把，我都摸清了。
lines.en: I know every torch on this street.

lines.zh: 我离你还有十一块砖。
lines.en: Eleven paving stones still lie between us.

lines.zh: 你把门关上了，我从窗进。
lines.en: You shut the door; I come through the window.

lines.zh: 我不急，夜晚很长。
lines.en: No haste needed; this night has hours left.

lines.zh: 你的影子先跑，你后跑。
lines.en: Your shadow runs first, then you.

lines.zh: 我绕了远路，正好堵住巷口。
lines.en: I took the long way and now block the alley mouth.

lines.zh: 呼吸声在墙那边，很清晰。
lines.en: Your breathing is clear on the other side of the wall.

lines.zh: 你藏得很好，只是鞋印没藏。
lines.en: You hid well; your shoe prints did not.

lines.zh: 我数到十，就进来。
lines.en: I count to ten, then I come in.

lines.zh: 我不抓喉咙，我抓手。
lines.en: I do not go for the throat; I go for the hands.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你会晕一会儿。
lines.en: This headbutt will daze you for a while.

lines.zh: 角顶在肋骨上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My horn hits your ribs with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 别动，我把你扛起来。
lines.en: Keep still; I am lifting you up.

lines.zh: 我把你按进麦秆堆里。
lines.en: I press you down into the straw pile.

lines.zh: 你挣扎得挺有力气。
lines.en: You struggle with decent strength.

lines.zh: 这一下不致命，我保证。
lines.en: This blow will not kill; I promise.

lines.zh: 你的手松开了，东西归我。
lines.en: Your hand opened; the thing is mine.

lines.zh: 我把你翻过来，看清你的脸。
lines.en: I turn you over to see your face.

lines.zh: 扛在肩上，比拖着省事。
lines.en: Over the shoulder is easier than dragging.

lines.zh: 别喊，喊声会引来狼。
lines.en: Do not shout; shouting draws wolves.

lines.zh: 这一脚，让你走不动。
lines.en: This kick will keep you from walking.

lines.zh: 你比上次那个轻。
lines.en: You are lighter than the last one.

lines.zh: 我只用了一半的力气。
lines.en: Half my strength was all that took.

lines.zh: 我从树后走出来，蹄子没响。
lines.en: I step out from behind the tree, hooves silent.

lines.zh: 田里的稻草人今晚多了一个。
lines.en: The field has one more scarecrow tonight.

lines.zh: 火把灭了一盏，我就在那。
lines.en: One torch went out, and I am there.

lines.zh: 雪地上先出现角，再出现我。
lines.en: The horns appear in the snow first, then me.

lines.zh: 我沿着田垄走到村口。
lines.en: I walk the furrows to the village gate.

lines.zh: 栅栏外面有影子，比栅栏高。
lines.en: There is a shadow past the fence, taller than the fence.

lines.zh: 我学了一声羊叫，没人出来。
lines.en: I bleat like a goat; nobody comes out.

lines.zh: 这家人今晚忘了关窗。
lines.en: This household forgot to shut the window.

lines.zh: 我从井边站直了身子。
lines.en: I straighten up beside the well.

lines.zh: 月亮下面，我比树高一点。
lines.en: Under the moon I stand a little taller than the trees.

lines.zh: 蹄印从林子里一直排到门口。
lines.en: Hoofprints run from the woods right to the door.

lines.zh: 风声里夹着一声不属于风的叫。
lines.en: The wind carries a call that is not wind.

lines.zh: 我在这片田里站了很久。
lines.en: I have stood in this field a long while.

lines.zh: 你家的狗先发现了我。
lines.en: Your dog found me first.

lines.zh: 着火了我就不打了，先跑。
lines.en: On fire, I stop fighting and simply run.

lines.zh: 从屋顶下来的时候摔了。
lines.en: I fell coming down from the roof.

lines.zh: 水没过角，我慌了。
lines.en: Water rose past my horns, and I panicked.

lines.zh: 田被炸开一个坑，我退了。
lines.en: The blast left a crater in the field; I withdrew.

lines.zh: 箭插在背上，我拔不掉。
lines.en: An arrow in my back that I cannot pull out.

lines.zh: 这味道让我角根发麻。
lines.en: This reek numbs the base of my horns.

lines.zh: 田里没剩多少，我得更贪。
lines.en: Little remains in the fields; I must be greedier.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了我的脸，我不喜欢。
lines.en: Lightning lit up my face; I dislike that.

lines.zh: 掉进这里，我连蹄声都没了。
lines.en: Fallen here, I have lost even my hoofbeats.
